about: Grid snap cases both apps run (web editor/gridSnap.ts, desktop core/GridSnap.h). Same file in both repos: web apps/web/src/editor/test/fixtures/grid-snap-vectors.json, desktop fixtures/grid-snap-vectors.json. offsets and drags come from vanilla BlueBrick 1.9.2 under Wine (scripts/bluebrick-oracle/bbsnap.cs): a part with its display area at area [x, y, w, h] (studs), grabbed at grab and dragged with the grid on and nothing to connect to, until the pointer is at mouse, ends with its display area centred on centre. IMPORTTEST.1 is a 5 x 2 stud imported-style part with a 1-stud left margin, made for the oracle. A grab at the part's centre is a drop from the parts list. points: a ruler end, label corner, text middle or venue corner on the nearest grid point; halfway goes to the even step, as C#'s Math.Round; grid 0 is off.
